Messages.Author: Silmegil
Messages.Body:
Izaak is actually quite right. Cost effectiveness of this offer is not as good as it sounds. I can see someone really using the BL cards, but that would be a special case. I actually am in contact with one of the biggest reseler shops at ebay and this offer is simply not good for him. Well I am glad each time someone buys cards to play them and use them, but this price is in my opinion a little too much. Seller would have better shot at selling by a) lowering overall price, b) splitting into parts. If the second option was done correctly, I believe it would raise even more money. I think it will not sell for this price, but I am fairly known for being often wrong B)

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
I don't think it will actually make $ 1500 even if split into smaller lots. I mean, sure, selling the whole bunch as singles will likely make over $1500 eventually, but that may take months or maybe even years to sell.

From the community, there is a lot of interest in the Bloodline cards for obvious reasons. Splitting those off would potentially lead to a juicy auction price *for those cards*, but most of the other cards -bar a few- are just cards that everyone has 10 of already. Probably the best way to sell this collection is to auction all the bloodlines stuff as a single lot and then list the remaining valuabe rares as singles. Then contact an established singles seller and negotiate a fair price with him for the remaining cards.
